SELECT b.bot_id AS botId, b.name AS name, b.avatar_image AS avatarImage, b.description AS description, CAST(COALESCE(x.net, 0) AS SIGNED) AS likeCount, CAST(COALESCE(x.net, 0) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS popularityScore, #{year} AS statYear, #{month} AS statMonth FROM ( SELECT e.bot_id AS bot_id, SUM(e.delta) AS net FROM BOT_RECOMMEND_EVENT e WHERE e.created_at >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND e.created_at < DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) GROUP BY e.bot_id HAVING SUM(e.delta) > 0 ) x JOIN BOT b ON b.bot_id = x.bot_id ORDER BY x.net DESC, b.bot_id ASC LIMIT 30

SELECT NULL AS ranking, b.bot_id AS botId, b.name AS name, b.avatar_image AS avatarImage, b.description AS description, b.like_count AS likeCount, CAST(b.like_count AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS popularityScore, #{year} AS statYear, #{month} AS statMonth FROM BOT b ORDER BY b.like_count DESC, b.bot_id ASC LIMIT 30

SELECT s.ranking AS ranking, b.bot_id AS botId, b.name AS name, b.avatar_image AS avatarImage, b.description AS description, b.like_count AS likeCount, s.popularity_score AS popularityScore, s.stat_year AS statYear FROM BOT_POPULARITY_STAT s JOIN BOT b ON b.bot_id = s.bot_id WHERE s.stat_year = #{year} AND s.stat_month = 0 ORDER BY (s.ranking IS NULL), s.ranking ASC, s.popularity_score DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT NULL AS ranking, b.bot_id AS botId, b.name AS name, b.avatar_image AS avatarImage, b.description AS description, b.like_count AS likeCount, CAST(b.like_count AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS popularityScore, #{year} AS statYear FROM BOT b ORDER BY b.like_count DESC, b.bot_id ASC LIMIT 15
